purpose: Locate the first exact expressive jump beyond the v7.5 tree closure. A three-component C4 interaction cycle already realizes orbit NEQ_3 in the relaxed capacity-respecting gain semantics, while a fully saturated three-C4 Hamiltonian source instance realizes orbit EQ_3 exactly. Thus cycle holonomy is genuinely expressive rather than merely obstructive. At the same time, exhaustive gain-state search shows that a three-C4 cycle cannot yet serve as a reusable two-terminal EQ/NEQ wire if the internal component is fully saturated and both terminals retain at least two external Hamiltonian half-edges. This freezes the next source-completion problem sharply.

semantics.components: Three complementary C4 components X,Z,Y with canonical orbit labels tau in {0,1,2} and component gauges in S3.
semantics.bundle_orientation: Use B:X->Z, C:Z->Y, A:Y->X. For an oriented bundle U->V, h_UV=g_V^{-1}g_U.
semantics.cycle_holonomy: A global gauge assignment exists exactly when accepted relative gains can be selected so that h_YX composed h_ZY composed h_XZ = identity.
semantics.terminal_relation: For fixed terminal orbit labels tau_X,tau_Y, existentially quantify tau_Z and all gauges, modulo fixing g_X=identity by global colour symmetry.

relaxed_NEQ_cycle.terminal_relation: NEQ_3 exactly: every unequal terminal orbit pair has three extensions after fixing g_X=id, and every equal pair has none.
relaxed_NEQ_cycle.meaning: The v7.5 tree language cannot realize NEQ_3 at all, but one interaction cycle can. The two external terminals already retain two Hamiltonian half-edges each. However Z retains four unused half-edges, so this is not yet a closed two-terminal source gadget; completing Z can add constraints and must be proved separately.

fully_source_realized_EQ_control.terminal_relation: EQ_3 exactly after existentially quantifying Z and gauges.
fully_source_realized_EQ_control.graph_control: All twelve Hamiltonian ports have H-degree two, the displayed H edges form one connected simple 12-cycle, and the complementary edges are exactly the three disjoint C4 cycles. Therefore this is a genuine simple 4-regular Hamiltonian source instance, not merely a relaxed port-capacity object.
fully_source_realized_EQ_control.meaning: A relation impossible in every interaction tree is already present as an exact internal holonomy relation in a true smooth-C4 Hamiltonian graph. Cycles add real expressive power.

reusable_three_cycle_gate.bundle_gain_state_definition: Two raw bundles are identified only when they have the same left port-usage vector, right port-usage vector, and the same nine-entry table of allowed relative S3-gain subsets over the 3x3 orbit pairs.
reusable_three_cycle_gate.internal_Z_saturation: Require usage_right(B)+usage_left(C)=[2,2,2,2], so the hidden component Z has no external Hamiltonian half-edge and the terminal relation is genuinely binary at the component level.
reusable_three_cycle_gate.terminal_reusability: Require X and Y each to retain at least two unused Hamiltonian half-edges after adding the closing A bundle.
reusable_three_cycle_gate.scope: This exhaustive search is performed in a relaxed superset that enforces exact per-port capacity and exact S3 gain/holonomy semantics but does not additionally require the partial H edges to be extendable to one global Hamiltonian cycle. Failure in this superset rules out every true three-C4 reusable binary gadget satisfying the same saturation/free-terminal conditions.

main_theorem.name: CYCLE_HOLONOMY_IS_THE_FIRST_C4_ORBIT_EXPRESSIVE_JUMP_BUT_TRIANGLE_WIRE_COMPLETION_IS_BLOCKED
main_theorem.statement: Capacity-respecting C4 interaction trees cannot realize EQ_3 or NEQ_3 (v7.5), whereas a three-component interaction cycle realizes NEQ_3 in exact gain semantics and a fully source-realized three-C4 Hamiltonian graph realizes EQ_3. Nevertheless no three-C4 cycle in the exhaustive gain-state closure realizes reusable EQ_3/NEQ_3 with the internal component saturated and at least two free Hamiltonian half-edges on each terminal.
proof_outline: The explicit NEQ control is verified directly by all 3x3 terminal orbit pairs, all three internal orbit choices and all 6x6 gauge pairs after fixing the root gauge.
The explicit EQ control is verified the same way; its Hamiltonian edge set is independently checked to be one 12-cycle with degree two at every port.
For the reusable-wire negative gate, enumerate all 7342 valid raw bundles and collapse them only by exact usage+gain-table equivalence, yielding 6511 gain-state types.
Enumerate every ordered B,C type pair that exactly saturates Z; compose their gain tables with existential tau_Z while retaining the full allowed S3 transfer set, yielding 46114 distinct path states.

For each path state enumerate every closing A gain type respecting per-port capacity and leaving at least two unused terminal half-edges on both X and Y. Apply the exact cycle inverse-gain/holonomy test to all nine terminal orbit pairs. Across 771960 compressed closing states neither EQ_3 nor NEQ_3 occurs.

positive: Identifies cycle holonomy as an actual source-relevant relation generator, not merely a consistency check.
Provides a genuine smooth-C4 Hamiltonian EQ_3 control with a replayable 12-cycle witness.
Provides the first capacity-respecting cyclic NEQ_3 relation with reusable external capacity on both named terminals.
negative: A three-C4 cycle is insufficient to turn the relaxed NEQ relation into a clean reusable binary wire while closing the hidden component.
The next reduction cannot hide the leftover Z ports by assertion; doing so may change the relation and must be carried explicitly.
firewall: The relaxed NEQ triangle is not yet claimed as an embeddable binary gadget in the original Hamiltonian source because its hidden Z component has four unfilled H half-edges.
The fully saturated EQ graph demonstrates source-realized holonomy but has no external terminal capacity and therefore is a control, not a reusable reduction wire.

next_target.name: E8_C4_FOURPLUS_COMPONENT_SOURCE_WIRE_COMPLETION_V7_7
next_target.directive: Search four-or-more C4 component cyclic gadgets for a genuinely reusable source wire: every hidden component must have H-degree exactly two at every port, both named terminal components must retain a controlled even number of external half-edges, and the internal H edges plus designated dangling ends must be completable by splicing into one simple Hamiltonian cycle. Track full S3 gain sets and holonomy, not only orbit masks. First target NEQ_3 using the v7.6 relaxed triangle as a seed and absorb Z's four free half-edges with source-neutral auxiliary C4 components. If exact EQ/NEQ is found, prove a compositional splicing lemma before using it in any hardness or solver claim.
